blurb: Balanced Fitness Studios delivers a fitness experience combining Pilates, strength and conditioning, and mindfulness techniques based on the Balanced Athlete® methodology. They focus on connecting mind and body to improve movement efficiency and undo imbalances caused by overuse or injury. Classes are designed to build strength, restore alignment, and improve coordination and mobility in small groups or personalized sessions.
